description: Open the dataset '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/SleepWide.csv' in JASP. This dataset contains sleep data for 10 patients in a wide format, with columns 'Drug1' and 'Drug2' representing extra sleep hours under two different conditions. Perform a Paired Samples T-Test comparing 'Drug1' and 'Drug2'. In the analysis options, enable 'Effect size' (Cohen's d) and 'Descriptives'. Also enable the 'Raincloud difference plot' under Plots. Verify the results appear in the output pane, then save the JASP analysis file as '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/SleepPairedTTest.jasp'.
